_doc: Cau hinh QUAN SAT SONG cua tung du an — Router Control Center V0.5.
KHONG BAO GIO dat noi dung bi mat o day. Chi duong dan/bi danh toi
khoa DA CO tren may (`key_path`). `config.kiem_cau_hinh()` tu choi ca
tep neu thay chu ky khoa rieng hay token, va tu choi moi khoa ten
`secret`/`password`/`token`/`credential` — vi tep nay nam trong kho
git, va mot khoa rieng lot vao day la mot su co khong hoan tac duoc
Moi du an deu duoc quan sat chung (Router + git) DU KHONG khai gi o
day. Phan khai them la CONG vao, khong phai thay the.
`type` hop le: router | git | ssh_service | unavailable.
